144:Treat the tool result and the Inspector render as separate outcomes. An exit code of `0` means the tool call succeeded and no hard render error occurred; it does not, by itself, prove the UI rendered. Confirm UI delivery with `inspectorRender.status === "rendered"`. If `inspectorRender.status === "skipped"`, branch on `inspectorRender.remediation` or the stable root `warning.code`. If `--require-render` is set, the same skipped-render issue moves from root `warning` to root `error` and the command exits with code `1`.
